dialogues.speaker: Helen
dialogues.text: *clears throat* ...

dialogues.speaker: Helen
dialogues.text: ...Um, excuse me? I was about to begin my song... I'm trying to protect Mondstadt here. This had better be important.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why the high stage?

dialogues.speaker: Helen
dialogues.text: Uh... the higher up you are, the further the sound travels. Everyone knows that... don't they?

dialogues.speaker: Helen
dialogues.text: So if I'm on a high perch, everyone in the city will be able to hear my song.

dialogues.speaker: Helen
dialogues.text: ...I actually wanted to do it on top of the statue of Barbatos, but the sisters stopped me. And they said if they caught me trying again, they'd put the Knights of Favonius onto me...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Protecting Mondstadt?

dialogues.speaker: Helen
dialogues.text: Well of course! Ever since I started performing my songs here, everything in Mondstadt has really cleared up. Obviously that's because of my efforts, right?

dialogues.speaker: Helen
dialogues.text: Maybe I'm a bard blessed by Barbatos... Hehehe...

dialogues.speaker: Helen
dialogues.text: ...You know, I bet if Barbatos was a bard, our skills would be equally matched!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Helen
dialogues.text: May the Wind of Mondstadt be with you... And the sound of my song, too!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you seen anyone around that looks a lot like me?

dialogues.speaker: Helen
dialogues.text: Oh, you're looking for someone, huh? Off the top of my head... no, nothing springs to mind.

dialogues.speaker: Helen
dialogues.text: I've duly noted your appearance, though. In the future, whenever I'm performing from somewhere high up, I'll keep an eye out for this missing person.

dialogues.speaker: Helen
dialogues.text: That's another advantage of being high up, in case you didn't know. You can see really far.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So where were you when Stormterror attacked?

dialogues.speaker: Helen
dialogues.text: Hmm? Uh... Ah yes, Stormterror. I was, uh...

dialogues.speaker: Helen
dialogues.text: That's right — I was at home, singing and playing away. And a short while afterwards, the storm stopped.

dialogues.speaker: Helen
dialogues.text: So it seems Stormterror isn't that powerful when faced with the sound of my song.

dialogues.speaker: Helen
dialogues.text: ...Now, where did I get up to? This is all your fault! I've forgotten the lyrics now...
